verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only fragments of the leaver side. Oneleet MDM can take remote action on devices being offboarded, and its integrations monitor user accounts and access in Google Workspace, GitHub and AWS IAM, which could help show a departed user lost access. Nothing documents HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists or training completion. Missing for 10: HR system integration/sync, onboarding/offboarding checklist workflows, security training assignment and completion tracking, per-employee audit evidence of access revocation, independent corroboration.
